description: Pioneering is the art of building with rope and spars: safety, knots and lashings, camp gadgets, rope types and strength, making rope, anchoring, trestles, and building a full-size structure such as a monkey bridge.

safety.note: Structures must follow the height and safety limits in the Guide to Safe Scouting, with adult supervision.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The official numbering skipped from 4 to 6 in the excerpts, so requirement 5 (formerly splicing) may have been removed; it is not outlined here.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
